PQdsplen.reason: The function returns an int (display length), not a pointer, so ownership and lifecycle do not apply.

PQparamtype.reason: The function returns an Oid (integer type), not a pointer, so ownership and lifecycle management do not apply.

PQconnectStart.reason: PQconnectStart allocates a new PGconn with makeEmptyPGconn and always returns it to the caller, who must eventually free it with PQfinish.

PQfmod.reason: PQfmod returns a plain int (the type modifier), not a pointer, so ownership does not apply.

pg_valid_server_encoding_id.reason: The function returns an int (not a pointer), so ownership and lifecycle questions do not apply, and it is safe to expose directly.

PQfformat.reason: PQfformat returns a plain int (no pointer), so ownership does not apply; it merely reads a field format from an existing PGresult.

PQescapeStringConn.reason: The function writes into a caller-supplied buffer and returns a size_t, so no heap pointer is returned and ownership does not apply.

PQgetisnull.reason: The function returns a plain int (not a pointer) and only reads from the provided PGresult without allocating or freeing any memory.

PQputCopyEnd.reason: PQputCopyEnd returns an integer status code, not a pointer, so ownership does not apply; it merely uses the existing PGconn handle to signal end of COPY-IN mode.

PQgetvalue.reason: The returned pointer points into internal storage owned by the PGresult; the caller must not free it, and it becomes invalid when the PGresult is cleared.

PQescapeLiteral.reason: PQescapeLiteral returns a newly allocated string (via PQescapeInternal) that the caller is responsible for freeing with PQfreemem.

PQresStatus.reason: Returns a pointer into a static string table (pgresStatus) or a library-managed translated string; the caller must not free it.

lo_lseek.reason: The function returns a plain int (seek position or error code), not a pointer, so ownership does not apply; it merely uses an existing large-object handle.

PQcopyResult.reason: PQcopyResult allocates a new PGresult via PQmakeEmptyPGresult and returns it to the caller, who must eventually free it with PQclear.

pg_encoding_to_char.reason: This function returns a pointer to a static string constant owned by the library; the caller must not free it.

PQenv2encoding.reason: The function returns a plain integer (encoding identifier) and manages no heap memory, so ownership and lifecycle concepts do not apply.
